title: 第124章 陛下，你能再坑点吗？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸面色顿时怪异起来，刚才觉得大炎高层不正规，现在忽然感觉……暗京楼的人也不正经啊！喂，老兄，你们是刺客啊！知道什么叫刺客吗？来无影去无踪，杀人夺命于无形，那才是刺客，才是杀手。你们现在在干啥？摆开阵势群殴呢？唐逸颇有一种高中时代被人拎着叫放学别走，码人找个位置找场子的错觉。关键是龙斩这操作吧，就像是让宁川等一众锦衣卫立正站稳了，他要甩大嘴巴子了……伤害不大，羞辱性极强啊！果然，唐逸看到宁川一群人脸色都阴沉无比。本来他们人多，现在他们人少了，而且暗京楼对面可全都是高手，真打起来他们讨不到什么便宜。“年轻人，挺狂啊！”一直没说话的炎文帝眼睛也是眯了起来。朕这个皇帝做得这么失败的吗？群臣不将朕放在眼里，你们这些阴沟里的老鼠，也敢不将朕放在眼里？真以为朕拿你们暗京楼没办法了？“了解下，这里是京都，是朕的地盘……”炎文帝抬手，随意拍了拍便服上并不存在的灰尘。“在这里要杀朕的人，好歹先问问朕的意见。”“不然朕要是生气了，你们可是都会死的，朕……不怎么喜欢杀人。”“但，你们，例外。”声音平静，却带着一股不容置疑的威慑。龙斩看着从容不迫的炎文帝，微微抱拳作揖：“不愧是皇帝，都这时候了还能宠辱不惊，佩服佩服。”“我知道，你这么平静，是因为这是你的圈套。”“我没猜错的话，你是想将我们暗京楼的人引来，然后一网打尽。”说到这里，龙斩一亮，苍白的脸也都红润了几分。时间充足，不如玩个游戏打发时间？他指着炎文帝，冲着文武百官世家大族笑道：“诸位，告诉你们吧，你们敬爱的皇帝陛下不仅拿自己当饵，怕筹码不够，又将你们所有人一起拉过来做饵。”“目的嘛，就是想要吸引我们暗京楼出动所有的力量，来杀他和杀你们。”听到这话，刘温，赵柯等一众大臣却齐齐看向炎文帝，全都愣住了。他们一开始还以为炎文帝让老太傅加码，是想给小诗仙铺路。现在才发现铺个鬼的路，皇帝的目标从一开始就是暗京楼，给唐逸铺路只是顺带而已。陛下，你能别这么坑吗？你这么玩，要是玩砸了大炎所有高层都死了，是会亡国的！“这样无德的皇帝，值得你们忠心吗？”龙斩手帕擦了擦嘴角，道：“这样吧，只要你们宣布从此不再效忠皇帝，今日可以饶你们不死，只要让家里送十万两赎金过来就行了。”“放心，今日皇帝和小诗仙必死，这里所发生的一切，将会成为我们所有人的秘密，不会有人知道的。”“很简单的，只要说一声：我自愿脱离大炎，从此不再为炎文帝效力，就可以活命了。”“不然，你们就只能跟着皇帝陪葬了。”众人盯着龙斩，脸皮都在轻微抽搐。既然你确定皇帝和唐逸必死，那你还多此一举干什么？你杀了皇帝和小诗仙，我们交赎金，岂不简单明了？“这么做，当然是让咱们的陛下在死亡前，感受什么叫众叛亲离啊！”龙斩指了指沈园外，道：“你们的时间不多，我给你们三个数的时间考虑，考虑不清楚，那就全都死吧！”“不要指望外面会有人来救你们，只要我不同意，这里就不会有人进得来。”“就算大炎的兵马杀过来，这期间也足够我杀了你们所有人了。”“三……二……”果然听到这话，很多人都面色恐惧。暗京楼敢这么猖狂，连皇帝都不放在眼里，明显是有足够的底气的。然而面对龙斩的挑拨，炎文帝却丝毫不在意。甚至看都没有看身边的群臣一眼，声音平静至极。“你们相信他，还是相信朕？”众人看向炎文帝，没了？你平时不是很能说的吗？你的计划呢？你的援兵呢？你能灭掉暗京楼的手段呢？好歹你说一点好让我们坚定一下信心啊。终于，在龙斩的压迫下，很多人眼中都有了狠意。陛下，是你先拿我们作饵，是你不仁在先。既然你不仁，那就别怪我们不义了。“龙舵主，我自愿脱离大炎，从此不再为炎文帝效力。”“我自愿脱离大炎，从此不再为炎文帝效力。”“……”当即，有人大声说道，其他人也纷纷附和，立即和炎文帝拉开了距离。龙斩的“一”字没落下，炎文帝的周围已经空了一大片，全都被暗京楼吓破胆，选择背叛了。炎文帝看着这一幕，脸色顿时阴沉至极，手都攥成了拳，骨头嘎嘣响。唐逸一直注意着炎文帝的脸色，见到炎文帝此时的表情他的目光便极为怪异，不知道是不是错觉，他总觉得炎文帝不是生气，分明是在激动啊！炎文帝自然是激动，他本来就想趁着丞相不在京都的这段时间，将丞相一党的势力给削了。这才打着瞌睡，暗京楼就把枕头给送来了。这些人是自愿脱离大炎，不再效忠大炎的，那处理他们还有问题吗？完全没问题。眼看着一下走出去二十余人，都是朝中各部门的大臣，大多出自丞相一党，炎文帝顿时美滋滋。等今日事情过了，他就能光明正大义正词严把这些人全砍了。届时，谁还敢不服？然后，这些位置他可以安排自己的心腹进来，将大权逐渐收回。当然现在要及时止损了，二十来个已经够了，要是再让事态发展下去，那就真让龙斩得逞，他真成孤家寡人了。“够了！龙斩是吧？你的花招耍完了是吧？那现在……到朕了。”炎文帝目光落在唐逸的身上，挥了挥手道：“前方统统散开，让唐逸来。”噗！唐逸差点当场喷了，啥玩意儿？是轮到你了，还是轮到我了？陛下，你能再坑点吗？
content_en: Tang Yi's face suddenly became weird. Just now he felt that the top management of Dayan was irregular, but now he suddenly felt that... the people in Anjing Tower were not serious either!Hey, man, you are assassins!Do you know what an assassin is?Coming and going without a trace, killing and taking lives invisible, that is the assassin, the killer.What are you doing now?How about setting up a group fight?Tang Yi had the illusion that when he was in high school, he was picked up and asked not to leave after school, and the coder found a place to find a place.The key is that Long Zhan's operation is like making Ning Chuan and other Jin Yiwei stand at attention, and he is going to talk loudly... It's not very harmful, but it's extremely humiliating!Sure enough, Tang Yi saw that the faces of the people in Ningchuan were extremely gloomy.They used to have a lot of people, but now they have fewer people, and the people opposite Anjing Tower are all experts, so they really can't get any advantage in a fight."Young man, you are quite crazy!" Emperor Yanwen, who had been silent for the whole time, also narrowed his eyes.Have I, the emperor, failed so much?The ministers don't take me seriously, how dare you, the rats in the gutter, not take me seriously?Do you really think there is nothing I can do against you An Jing Tower?"Understand, this is Kyoto, my territory..." Emperor Yanwen raised his hand and casually patted the non-existent dust on his casual clothes."Those who want to kill me here should at least ask me for my opinion first." "Otherwise, if I get angry, you will all die. I... don't like killing people very much." "But you are an exception." The voice was calm, but with an undoubted intimidation.Long Zhan looked at Emperor Yanwen who was calm and unhurried, and bowed slightly with his fists: "As expected of the emperor, he is still unfazed by favors and humiliations at this time. I admire him." "I know that you are so calm because this is your trap." "If I am not wrong, you want to attract our people from the Anjing Tower and catch them all." After saying this, Long Zhan lit up, and his pale face became a little rosy.You have enough time, why not play a game to pass the time?He pointed at Emperor Yanwen and smiled at the wealthy civil and military officials: "Everyone, let me tell you, your beloved Emperor not only used himself as bait, but for fear of not having enough chips, he also pulled all of you together as bait." "The purpose is to attract all the power of our Anjing Tower to kill him and you." Hearing this, Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers all looked at Emperor Yanwen, and they were all stunned.At first, they thought that Emperor Yanwen asked the old master to step up his game because he wanted to pave the way for the little Shixian.Only now did I realize that the emperor's goal was to pave the way for him from the beginning, and paving the way for Tang Yi was just incidental.Your Majesty, can you stop being such a cheat?If you play this way, if all the high-level officials in Dayan die, the country will be destroyed!"Is such an unscrupulous emperor worthy of your loyalty?" Long Zhan wiped the corners of his mouth with a handkerchief and said, "Let's do this. As long as you declare that you will no longer be loyal to the emperor, I can spare your life today, as long as your family sends a ransom of 100,000 taels." "Don't worry, the emperor and Xiao Shixian will die today. What happened hereEverything will become a secret for all of us, and no one will know it.""It's very simple, just say: I voluntarily leave Dayan and no longer serve Emperor Yan Wen, and you can live." "Otherwise, you will have to be buried with the emperor." Everyone stared at Long Zhan, their faces twitching slightly.Since you are sure that the emperor and Tang Yi will die, why are you doing this in vain?You kill the emperor and the little poet, and we pay the ransom. Isn't it simple and clear?"What we do is, of course, to make our Majesty feel what it means to betray one's relatives before he dies!" Long Zhan pointed outside Shen Garden and said, "You don't have much time. I'll give you three times to think about it. If you can't think clearly, then all of you will die!" "Don't point fingers!I hope someone will come to save you.As long as I don't agree, no one will be able to come in. ""Even if Dayan's soldiers and horses come to kill you, it will be enough for me to kill all of you." "Three...two..." As expected, many people looked frightened when they heard this.An Jinglou dared to be so arrogant, even the emperor didn't look down on him, so he obviously had enough confidence.However, Emperor Yanwen didn't care at all when faced with Long Zhan's provocation.He didn't even look at the ministers around him, his voice was extremely calm."Do you believe him, or do you believe me?" Everyone looked at Emperor Yanwen, no?Aren't you usually very eloquent?What's your plan?Where are your reinforcements?What method can you use to destroy Anjing Tower?At least you can say something so that we can strengthen our confidence.Finally, under the pressure of Long Zhan, many people had cruel intentions in their eyes.Your Majesty, you were the first to use us as bait, and you were the first to be unkind.Since you are unkind, don't blame us for being unjust."Lord Dragon Helm, I voluntarily leave Great Yan and will no longer serve Emperor Yanwen." "I voluntarily leave Great Yan and will no longer serve Emperor Yanwen." "..." Immediately, someone said loudly, and others also agreed and immediately distanced themselves from Emperor Yanwen.Before Long Zhan could even pronounce the word "一", a large area was already empty around Emperor Yan Wen. They were all frightened by Anjing Tower and chose to betray.Emperor Yanwen looked at this scene, his face suddenly became extremely gloomy, his hands clenched into fists, and his bones cracked.Tang Yi had been paying attention to Emperor Yanwen's face. When he saw Emperor Yanwen's expression at this time, his eyes looked very strange. He didn't know if it was an illusion, but he always felt that Emperor Yanwen was not angry, but clearly excited!Emperor Yanwen was naturally excited. He originally wanted to take advantage of the Prime Minister's absence in Kyoto to reduce the power of the Prime Minister's party.Just then he dozed off, and An Jinglou sent him a pillow.These people voluntarily left Great Yan and were no longer loyal to Great Yan. Is there any problem in dealing with them?No problem at all.Emperor Yanwen was immediately delighted when he saw more than 20 people walking out, all ministers from various departments in the court, most of them from the prime minister's party.After today's incident is over, he will be able to kill all these people openly and righteously.By then, who would dare to dissent?Then, he can arrange for his confidants to come in from these positions and gradually take back the power.Of course, the loss must be stopped in time. Twenty or so is enough. If the situation continues to develop, Long Zhan will really succeed and he will really be alone."That's enough! Dragon Slash, right? You're done with your tricks, right? Now... it's up to me." Emperor Yan Wen's eyes fell on Tang Yi, and he waved his hand and said: "Everyone in the front spread out and let Tang Yi come." Pfft!Tang Yi almost squirted on the spot, what the hell?Is it your turn or is it my turn?
title_en: Chapter 124 Your Majesty, can you trick me more?
